subject: Proposed School-Based DEI Director Position
overview: The subcommittee discussed the collaborative relationship between the Medford Public Schools and the City’s Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) Director. Members voted to recommend creating a new school-based DEI position while maintaining a stipend-supported partnership with the city's director.

items.title: Call to order and roll call
items.summary: The meeting was called to order with three members present.

items.title: Discussion on Resolution 2024-40: DEI Consolidation
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed a resolution regarding the city's DEI Director and ADA Coordinator providing support for school-based crisis management, HR, and training needs. Members expressed concerns regarding staffing capacity, legal distinctions between city and school employees, and student privacy.

items.title: Testimony from City DEI Director
items.summary: City DEI Director Frances Nwajei explained her role as a civil rights representative and clarified that she does not access student information except in extreme ADA accommodation cases or by student invitation. She described her work as a collaborative partnership focused on compliance, recruitment, and employee relations.

items.title: Review of neighboring district models
items.summary: Member Ruseau presented research on DEI staffing in Watertown, Arlington, and Somerville to compare different organizational structures between municipal and school departments.

items.title: Recommendation for school-based DEI position
items.summary: Referred a recommendation to the full School Committee to create a new job description for a school-based DEI director while continuing a stipend for the city director to ensure ongoing collaboration. The motion included a request for the Superintendent to recommend a specific stipend amount by mid-December.
